title: Active StockSmart Programs and the Reactivated Ship-To Level
content:
Where the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program is still running at a suspended delivery location, the Ship-To Fulfillment Account comes back closer to its prior level.

**Clause.** A StockSmart program still serving the ship-to takes drops back, the program read being the ship-to's program whose status is active (a closed, paused, terminating or enrolled program is never read): two drops are taken back where that program is StockSmart Onsite Storeroom, one where it is at any other StockSmart tier, and none where the ship-to has no active program.

### Program and drops taken back

| StockSmart program at the ship-to | Drops taken back |
|---|---|
| active, tier StockSmart Onsite Storeroom | 2 |
| active, tier StockSmart Self-Scan, StockSmart Monthly Service, StockSmart Biweekly Service, StockSmart Weekly Service or StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service | 1 |
| paused, terminating, enrolled or closed only, or no program | none |

The program is the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program record whose ship-to is this delivery location and whose status is active; its tier is the program tier shown on that record.

*Hypothetical cases:* a ship-to served by an active StockSmart Weekly Service program has one drop taken back. A ship-to whose program is paused has none taken back, even when it was StockSmart Onsite Storeroom.
